PROFILE.name: Srijan Bhattacharyya
PROFILE.title: Embedded Systems Engineer
PROFILE.about-me: I am Srijan Bhattacharyya, an Embedded Systems Engineer with a passion for creating innovative solutions that bridge the gap between hardware and software. With a strong foundation in computer science and hands-on experience in designing and implementing embedded systems, I thrive on tackling complex challenges and delivering efficient, reliable, and scalable solutions. My expertise spans across various domains including IoT, robotics, and real-time systems. I am dedicated to continuous learning and staying updated with the latest advancements in technology to ensure that my work remains at the forefront of the industry. When I'm not immersed in coding or tinkering with hardware, I enjoy exploring new technologies, contributing to open-source projects, and sharing knowledge with the tech community.

EDUCATION.university: Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology

PROJECTS.name: I.S.H.A (Integrated Systematic Heuristic Agent)
PROJECTS.description: ISHA is a multi-layered, open-source framework that bridges complex philosophy and psychology with AI and Robotics to achieve autonomous, human-like reasoning and goal-oriented evolution.

PROJECTS.name: DevOS EcoSystem
PROJECTS.description: DevOS EcoSystem is a unified suite of operating systems for desktops, laptops, mobiles, wearables, Raspberry Pi, and cars. With a shared core, DevPKG manager, and OctaConn connectivity, it aims to support integration, customization, and inter-device communication across different platforms.

PROJECTS.name: The AVR/ESP Programmer Board
PROJECTS.description: A compact hardware tool designed to program and communicate with AVR microcontrollers over ISP and ESP microcontrollers over UART, for robotics and IoT development workflows.
